title.narrative: General Volunteer Project for Knowledge Enrichment and Transfer - The Blind Paramedic

description.narrative: An initiative aimed at training individuals with visual impairments to become paramedics capable of providing first aid and assistance in emergencies. The project focuses on empowering this group in the community to develop their skills and achieve independence.

Empower individuals: provide people with visual impairments the knowledge and skills needed to help them respond effectively in emergencies. Raise awareness: increase community awareness of the ability of people with visual impairments to contribute to emergency and paramedic services. Provide training: offer specialized training courses in first aid and emergency response.
